video_title: “We Take A Lot Of Pride In Playing Like This.” | Bones Hyland Postgame Sound | 10.30.26

quotes.speaker: Bones Hyland
quotes.summary_phrase: Bones Hyland on the bench unit's impact and identity
quotes.excerpt: We know we got to give them a different dynamic when we step into the game.
quotes.quote: A lot of pride, honestly. We know we got to give them a different dynamic when we step into the game. If the first unit don't have it rolling, the bench we got a big job when we come into the game. We got to change the game. That's something I've been preaching since last year, coming in, changing the game, changing the pace, and I think we did a good job of that.
quotes.social_post: Bones Hyland says the Timberwolves bench unit takes pride in their role of changing the game and pace when they check in. He notes they have a big job to provide a different dynamic if the starters are not rolling.

structured.context: Bones Hyland discusses the identity and impact of the Minnesota Timberwolves bench unit after a game.

quotes.speaker: Bones Hyland
quotes.summary_phrase: Bones Hyland on his increased role and aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: My teammates finding me, making the game easy for me, finding me in the flow.
quotes.quote: Obviously, there's a lot of more opportunity out there to step in. But I think it's honestly for me just going with the flow of the game. My teammates finding me, making the game easy for me, finding me in the flow, getting the threes rolling, getting downhill. So yeah, like you said, just the green light, but don't let it be too much of it. Getting everybody involved too as well.
quotes.social_post: Bones Hyland on his approach to his increased opportunity this season: It is about going with the flow of the game and finding a balance between having the green light and getting his teammates involved.

structured.context: Bones Hyland reflects on his increased playing opportunities and his approach to balancing scoring with playmaking.

quotes.speaker: Bones Hyland
quotes.summary_phrase: Bones Hyland praises Jaden McDaniels' impact
quotes.excerpt: Shout out Jaden McDaniels tonight too. He stepped up big tonight.
quotes.quote: I'm learning a lot from Jaden McDaniels. Shout out Jaden McDaniels tonight too. He stepped up big tonight. He stepped in to a role where he's coming in and disrupting the game, making corner threes, getting out, getting dunks. So it takes a lot for that.
quotes.social_post: Bones Hyland is praising Jaden McDaniels for his impact tonight, specifically highlighting his ability to disrupt the game defensively and hit corner threes.

structured.context: Bones Hyland praises Jaden McDaniels for his performance and his ability to disrupt the game.

quotes.speaker: Bones Hyland
quotes.summary_phrase: Bones Hyland on Rudy Gobert's role as a roller
quotes.excerpt: It's a pocket game where you catch and kick it out.
quotes.quote: We know they're like one of them early low-man teams. We told Rudy Gobert once it's catching, kick out. It's a pocket game where you catch and kick it out. I think Rudy Gobert did a good job of that. Rudy Gobert is actually excellent at it when they're catching. Sometimes he'll go with it, he feels like he can finish, but he kicks out a lot and I think that helps us as a team on the short roll pass for sure.
quotes.social_post: Bones Hyland explains the team strategy for Rudy Gobert on the short roll, noting that Gobert is doing a good job of kicking the ball out to shooters when opposing teams collapse on him.

structured.context: Bones Hyland explains the tactical adjustments made regarding Rudy Gobert's role as a roller in the offense.

quotes.speaker: Bones Hyland
quotes.summary_phrase: Bones Hyland on team leadership and Jaden McDaniels' growth
quotes.excerpt: Telling Jaden McDaniels step up more, be a leader, be the voice of the team.
quotes.quote: We always preach to Jaden McDaniels, start with you. And Ant sent the video to the chat yesterday and the two-minute video just talking to us and getting us going, telling Jaden McDaniels step up more, be a leader, be the voice of the team. So I think that was pretty dope after a successful surgery.
quotes.social_post: Bones Hyland reveals that Anthony Edwards sent a two-minute video to the team chat challenging Jaden McDaniels to step up and be a vocal leader for the Timberwolves.

structured.context: Bones Hyland describes how Anthony Edwards encouraged Jaden McDaniels to take on a larger leadership role within the team.
